outputs.block:0:text:0: Zeitz MOCAA展示了Were It Not for Shadows...... ,集体展览集中了六位基于开普敦的艺术家的独特实践――Kemang Wa Lehulere, Laying Bare(2019);Haroon Gunn-Salie, Line in the Sand(2020);Thania Petersen,KASSARAM(2021);Igshaan Adams,‘Not Working;(Working Title)’(2022);Unathi Mkonto,‘TO LET’(2023);和Berni Searle,On Site。
